title: Villages in the Ottoman temettuat (income) registers of the 1840s, with their recorded land uses (UrbanOccupationsOETR, Koç University; Zenodo)
describe: A geographic sample of villages in six Ottoman regions (Ankara, Bursa, Edirne, Manisa, Plovdiv, Ruse) whose households' fields, vineyards and gardens were recorded in the temettuat income registers of the 1840s; the source dates the registers to the 1840s, so the villages are shown for that decade.
